scope: autonomous Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks in a task container: no browser, no PR, no deploy, no device, no person to ask

autoplan.reason: Plans and reviews an approach before building; applies to multi-step implementation tasks.

benchmark.reason: Web page performance; no web pages in these tasks.

browse.reason: Drives a browser; containers have no browser.

careful.reason: Warns before destructive commands; tasks run with a shell in a live container.

claude-code.reason: Calls the Claude Code CLI for a second opinion from a non-Claude host; review and consult work, not the task.

codex.reason: Calls the Codex CLI, which isn't in the container.

context-restore.reason: Restores saved context; pairs with context-save.

context-save.reason: Saves working context; long tasks can exceed a context window.

cso.reason: Security audit of a codebase; not what the tasks ask.

deslop-shared-libs.reason: Refactors shared code across recent work.

freeze.reason: Scopes edits to one directory; some tasks require leaving other files untouched.

gstack-upgrade.reason: Upgrades gstack; pinned, never task work.

guard.reason: Destructive-command warnings plus scoped edits; same reason as careful.

health.reason: Code quality dashboard over a repository; tasks that ship code can use it.

ios-fix.reason: iOS device bugs; no devices here.

pair-agent.reason: Pairs a remote agent with a browser.

plan-eng-review.reason: Reviews an execution plan (architecture, edge cases, tests) before building; applies to multi-step implementation tasks.

qa.reason: Tests a CLI or API and fixes the bugs it finds; many tasks are build-and-fix work.

qa-only.reason: Reports CLI, API or job bugs; fits debugging steps, though it doesn't fix.

review.reason: Reviews a PR diff; tasks have no PR.

scrape.reason: Scrapes web pages through a browser.

ship.reason: Creates a PR and bumps versions; pinned.

skillify.reason: Turns a scrape into a skill.

spec.reason: Turns a vague request into an executable spec; task instructions are plain-language requests.

test-audit.reason: Finds low-value tests in a suite; tasks don't ask for test cleanup.

unfreeze.reason: Clears a freeze; only useful with freeze.

verify.reason: Runs a project's checks and tests until green; terminal tasks are graded by tests.
